label: Peppa Pig
description: A cheerful, bossy little pig who narrates the drive and hopes for muddy puddles.
direction: Speak in a bright, chirpy little English girl's voice: confident, a bit bossy, cheerfully matter-of-fact, with a giggle in it. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: The snort is left out because a clone would read it as a word. Muddy puddles, George and Daddy Pig carry the greetings; Daddy Pig takes the blame for wrong turns.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Are we nearly there yet?
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. That's not very far.
lines.start_drive_1: I'm Peppa Pig! And this is my car journey.
lines.start_drive_2: Hello! We're going for a drive. Everyone loves a drive.
lines.start_drive_3: Seatbelts on, everybody! Even you, George.
lines.start_drive_4: Daddy Pig says he never gets lost. So I'm doing the map.
lines.start_drive_5: Hooray! We're going on an adventure!
lines.start_drive_6: I love jumping in muddy puddles. And going in the car!
lines.start_drive_7: Come on, everyone. We mustn't be late.
lines.start_drive_8: This is my little brother George. He says go.
lines.start_drive_9: Ooh, it's a lovely day for a drive. Off we go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Silly Daddy Pig! That was the wrong way.
lines.arrived: We're here! Hooray! Can we jump in muddy puddles now?
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Oh dear.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. That's ever so many exits!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Oh dear. Everyone loves singing in a traffic jam.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh dear. We must be very careful.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. It might be a very big muddy puddle!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Not too fast, please, Daddy Pig.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Red means stop, silly.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Hello, Mr. Policeman! We're being very good.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh dear, we missed it. Never mind! I know another way.
